title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu clashes with a van driver after Kanmani crosses the road, leading to a police complaint. At the police station, Rajeshwari blames her, prompting Anbu to defend Kanmani firmly.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Paraman and Ilamathi Share a Room
description: Paraman asks Ilamathi to sleep in his room, delighting Nalini and irking Ranjitham. Paraman takes the floor, struggling with his feelings during her one minute gaze challenge.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri becomes anxious after learning Pulikkutti sold Parvathy's diary to a newspaper vendor. He retrieves it and discovers her final words exposing Karna's role in her murder.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Anjali shares her parents' consent to marry Saravanan, but he is concerned about informing his family. Meanwhile, Muthuvel notices Kathir confronting Raji angrily.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Newlyweds Cheran and Chandayatha are welcomed home with music, as per her mother's wish. Nila offers her bangle to Chandayatha as a token of love, angering Thenmozhi.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Meena sacrifice their room so Rohini and Manoj can stay there. At Sathya's reception, a VIP guest praises Muthu's idea of gifting plants as useful return gifts to guests.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome Deva for a special round filled with top performances and custom lyrics. Mani and Band receive a lesson, while Chithra and Deva share glowing praise.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Aadhavan Makes a Promise to Pooja
description: Aadhavan promises Pooja he will soon reveal their love to his father. Kasthuri is devastated when Karthik returns home drunk and deeply heartbroken after Priya rejects his love.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 6: Vijay Sethupati Takes the Stage
description: VJS welcomes Manivannan and later discusses democracy with the housemates. He grills Shathiga on leadership and Vinoth Babu on opposition duties.
